answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a horizon seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A pre-written answer bank as a result goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 85 aliases trips the duplicate check at the kernel gate. The crystal receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. Each copy needs 4 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
